title: StepRecordedV3
description: Agent to gateway: one step of the investigation loop, sent after its checkpoint. The payload is the agent's stored StepRecorded v2 event, field for field and with the same nullability and limits (StepRecordedV2 in services/agent/src/agent/steps.py), plus the investigation, seq and time. Producers emit this version.

seq.description: Position of the step in its investigation, starting at 1.

summary.description: 1 to 2,000 characters, counted as Unicode code points.

tool_call_id.description: Id of the tool result; evidence cites it. Set on tool_call steps only.

result.description: What the tool returned; null when the call failed or the step called no tool. Called observation in stored v1 events.

latency_ms.description: How long the tool call took; null when unknown, as for steps first stored as v1.

tokens.description: Model tokens the step used; null when unknown, as for steps first stored as v1.

examples.summary: Log search timed out; deploy history is the only evidence for the v1.8.0 hypothesis so far.

examples.result: Error rate rose from 0.2% to 14% at 11:52.
